title: Landing redesign — a few locks
question: You shared a real studio photo (it shows BubbleBliss on the arch). Pick the path that matches how we should redesign the Zen Baby Studio landing page.

options.label: Photo as hero · new site world
options.kicker: RECOMMENDED IF THIS IS YOUR SPACE
options.body: Use the studio photo as a full-bleed first-viewport hero for Zen Baby Studio (crop/overlay so BubbleBliss wordmark isn’t the brand read). Replace the current cream-and-sage “Limewash Retreat” system with a quieter greige/taupe world drawn from the room: matte plaster walls, warm arch glow, white linen stations. Landing redesign ships that world; DESIGN.md updates to match. Still one offer, Book as primary action, no fake proof.

options.label: Photo as hero · landing only
options.body: Hero and landing composition rebuild around the real photo and arched architecture, but keep the existing cream/sage tokens and Cormorant/DM Sans pairing elsewhere. Faster, less systemic change — good if admin/booking should stay visually identical.

options.label: Mood only · invent new world
options.body: Treat the photo as private art direction only — don’t put it on the live site (e.g. BubbleBliss branding conflict, or not ready for public). Still redesign the landing with a replacement visual world inspired by that atmosphere, using authored/placeholder imagery instead of the raw photo.
